The photos show a cauldron-shaped net climber, a lantern tower with slides, a twisted purple climber and a swing frame, grouped into one site. It suits a resort, theme garden or large township park that wants its play area to have a character children remember. The colour scheme is multi-colour, with purple carrying the theme. This is a concept design from our Conceptual collection, so the number of pieces and the footprint are decided with you. items.pText: Witch's Enchantment is a themed play area built around a story of witches and wizards. The photos show a cauldron-shaped net climber, a lantern tower with slides, a twisted purple climber and a swing frame, grouped into one site. It suits a resort, theme garden or large township park that wants its play area to have a character children remember. The colour scheme is multi-colour, with purple carrying the theme. This is a concept design from our Conceptual collection, so the number of pieces and the footprint are decided with you. Tell us the size of your plot and the ages you expect, and our design team will propose a layout.

Specifications for Witch's Enchantment are drawn up for each order, because the cauldron climber, lantern tower and swing frame can be combined in different ways. Our layout drawing marks a safe play area around every piece, including the full swing arc. Installation is self-standing or grouted, depending on the soil. Plan for regular checks of the nets and slide joints once the area is open.
